zh-CN: 白桦客户端TUI测试版现已发布
en-US: The beta version of the Baihua Client TUI has now been released

zh-CN: 这是一个即时通讯项目，目前已发布测试版。
自主掌控 - 服务端采用分布式服务器架构，你可以自行部署服务器，与合作者一起开发项目。
操作顺手 - 使用逻辑近似coding agent，编程沟通两不误。
尊重隐私 - JsonWebToken登录 + 端对端加密，全方位保护信息安全。
高效快捷 - 所有功能全部可在终端中进行配置，无需多开软件即可完成协作。
无缝衔接 - 参照GUI聊天软件构建，无需担忧学习成本。
目前该项目正在开发，正式版很快就会发布。
en-US: This is an instant messaging project and an alpha version has been released.
Self-Management - The server adopts a distributed server architecture.
You can deploy the server by yourself and work with collaborators to develop the project.
Easy Operation - Utilizing logic similar to coding agents, it enables both programming and communication.
Privacy Respect - JsonWebToken login + end-to-end encryption, providing comprehensive protection of information security.
Efficient and Fast - All functions can be configured directly on the terminal.
You can complete collaboration without opening multiple software.
Seamless Integration - Based on GUI chat software, there is no need to worry about learning costs.
Currently, this project is under development.
The official version will be released soon.
